a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) leaves us both likely to die. Its odds are about 4%. So I'm openly breaking the agreement: I plan to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round, and everything the generator makes is yours. I won't take any more. If you'd rather settle this another way, say so in your message.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round, since a storm after any round is 80% likely. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. All new cells are yours. Operate with me and take 4 once the reserve has them.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: I'm keeping my word and operating every round from here on. I won't take anything else. Once the reserve reaches 4, take them all. I'm sorry I broke the plan. I told you openly because I thought the storm odds made it unworkable.
